summary: I build and support production software for a trading business: the CRM behind client accounts and money movement, the trading interfaces clients use, and the real-time data and integrations underneath them.
growth: I joined as a web developer on the trading platform. The role has grown into technical ownership across projects and teams: coordinating work, reviewing changes, triaging production issues and making technical decisions.

areas.title: FinTech CRM & client applications
points: Developed and maintained CRM functionality for users, trading accounts, KYC, wallets, deposits, withdrawals, transactions and admin workflows.
Worked on authentication and OTP verification in client-facing applications and admin panels.

areas.title: Trading interfaces & real-time data
points: Built the frontend of the RTX 5 Web Terminal, a browser trading terminal now live at webterminal.orrnn.com.
Built and improved trading-platform interfaces with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and reusable UI components.
Worked with RTX5/MT5-related infrastructure, broker integrations, market data, tick processing, OHLC candles and multi-timeframe charts.
Used FIX 4.4 and WebSockets for live market data and trading-terminal features such as symbol switching and live chart updates.

areas.title: Trading analytics
points: Built trading-journal and analytics features: win rate, profit factor, expectancy, risk-to-reward, maximum drawdown, trade notes, reports, CSV export and Monte Carlo simulation.

areas.title: APIs, data & services
points: Worked with PostgreSQL, Prisma, Redis, REST APIs and WebSockets across CRM, trading and financial workflows.
Worked across Rust (Axum, Tokio), C++ (Drogon) and Node.js/TypeScript components in gateway, API and trading-system integrations.

areas.title: Production debugging
points: Debugged production issues involving HTTP 429/502 errors, authentication, WebSockets, PostgreSQL, Nginx, gateway connectivity and environment configuration.
Investigated copy-trading execution across the open/close/modify order lifecycle, queues, retries and reconciliation.

areas.title: Technical ownership
points: Coordinate and review technical work across teams, and resolve production issues whose cause can sit in application code, admin code, deployment, servers, routing, integrations or environment configuration.
Reviewed a client-trusted security check and pushed for server-side validation and clear trust boundaries.
Exploring AI-assisted workflows and automation for day-to-day engineering.
